name: ribbon
description: A slim band above the prompt: how much of your 5-hour and 7-day usage is left, when each resets, and whether the prompt cache is warm or cold with what the next message costs.

usage.title: Usage figure
usage.description: left shows how much of each window is left; used shows how much is spent, as Claude Code's own rate-limit figures do

first.title: First window
first.description: Which usage window the band shows first: 7d (the weekly one) or 5h (the 5-hour one)

label.title: USAGE label
label.description: shown puts the word USAGE at the start of the band; hidden leaves just the windows

colors.title: Window colours
colors.description: fixed draws 7D orange and 5H yellow; level colours each window by the share used: green under 50%, yellow from 50%, red from 80%

align.title: Layout
align.description: packed keeps the blocks together at the left; spread spaces them evenly so the band fills its width

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: The band's text size on desktop, VS Code and mobile; the terminal has one size and ignores it. Larger sizes stack the band sooner so nothing clips
